recentItems.title: Jio Platforms IPO: India’s Biggest-Ever IPO At ₹30,188 Crore | Isha Ambani Speaks | Business News
recentItems.description:
Jio Platforms’ historic IPO marks a major milestone for Reliance Industries and India’s digital economy. At the upper end of the price band, the ₹30,188 crore issue is set to be India’s largest-ever IPO.

At the launch event, Isha Ambani reflects on Jio’s journey from its 2016 launch to 53 crore customers, revealing Reliance’s philosophy of long-term vision, scale, execution and financial discipline. She also pays tribute to Dhirubhai Ambani’s legacy and the family’s commitment to “Growth Is Life.”

recentItems.title: Jio Platforms IPO Press Conference LIVE | Mukesh Ambani & Top Leadership Address Investors
recentItems.description:
Watch the LIVE coverage of the much-awaited Jio Platforms IPO press conference as the company’s top leadership addresses the media following the filing of its Red Herring Prospectus (RHP). Reliance’s digital and telecom arm is gearing up for what could be India’s largest-ever public offering, targeting ₹30,213 crore.

With the IPO price band set at ₹1,065–₹1,119 per share, anchor bidding is scheduled to begin on Monday, October 19, followed by public subscription from October 21 to October 23.

Stay tuned for key insights from the management on Jio Platforms’ valuation, growth strategy, business outlook and the significance of this landmark IPO for investors and the Indian stock market.

recentItems.title: HORROR In Pakistan School: Roof Collapse Kills Children In Peshawar, Rescue Teams Search Debris
recentItems.description:
HORROR In Pakistan School: Roof Collapse Kills Children In Peshawar, Rescue Teams Search Debris

A tragic incident in Peshawar, Pakistan, has left children dead after a school roof reportedly collapsed. Rescue teams have been working through the rubble, with bodies being recovered from the debris.

The incident has raised urgent questions about building safety and the conditions of school infrastructure. Further details about the victims, the cause of the collapse and the official response are awaited.
